title: First Dirichlet eigenvalue of the weighted 1-Laplacian operator
summary: In this paper, we study the eigenvalue problem \[\left\{\begin{array}{cl}-\hbox{div}\left(a(x)\frac{Du}{|Du|}\right)=Λ\, b(x)\frac{u}{|u|} & \text{in }Ω\\u=0 & \text{on }\partialΩ,\end{array}\right.\] where $a(x)$ and $b(x)$ are suitable nonnegative functions. We prove that the first eigenvalue coincides with the weighted Cheeger constant. To see this identity, we analyze the behavior of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the weighted $p$-Laplacian operator as $p$ goes to $1$.
